admission_rule: A primary case requires an exact naturally generated prefix from the primary checkpoint, a native greedy verified covered duplicate, and an already emitted same-prefix sampled row that crop review assigns to one verified uncovered physical owner of the same category and tokenized row length. Terminal, malformed, unsupported, benign-uncovered, and unresolved outcomes remain diagnostics or refusals and cannot enter the promotion denominator. Reconstructed, teacher-forced, reordered, and supplementary same-prefix sampled prefixes are excluded.
